module: GE extension that opens the UI tutorial popups (UI hook OpenTutorialPopup). A popup is described by a content folder (by default /gameplay/tutorials/pages/<id>/) containing content.json (title, text, image, rows, Vue component) or content.html. The module reads these files, translates the texts and sends the list of entries to the UI. It also offers predefined popups (driving assists, challenge selection, contract, drag).
notes: In openDragTimeslipTutorialPopup, the variable `slip` is never defined (nil global): entry.slip stays nil. Also, if the content 'v2/dragStripTimeslipIntro' is not found, entry is nil and the list {entry} is empty.

For a content.json whose vueComponent is DragTimeslipTutorialPopup, entry.slip comes from options.slip or from gameplay_drag_dragBridge.createTimeslipData(). For ApmOnboardingPopup, entry.startingMoney (default 0) and entry.endMoney (default 10000) come from the options.
If content.json exists, content.html is ignored. Relative images are resolved relative to the popup folder; a path starting with '/' is kept as is.
The option options.context allows translating title/text via core_locales.contextTranslate; the rows texts always use _tr.

resolveAssetPath.desc: Builds a resource path: returns assetPath as is if it starts with '/', otherwise basePath concatenated with assetPath.

returns.desc: nil if assetPath is nil or empty.

readPopupEntryById.desc: Reads a popup's content: content.json (priority) or content.html, and returns an entry {id, type='info', isPopup=true, title, text, image, aspectRatio, vueComponent, topics, rows...} or {id, content, ...} for HTML.

options.desc: root (default '/gameplay/tutorials/pages/'), context (translation context), slip, startingMoney/startMoney, endMoney/money.

returns.desc: The entry, or nil if neither file exists.

openPopupEntries.desc: Sends already built entries to the UI via guihooks.trigger('OpenTutorialPopup', {popups = entries}).

returns.desc: false if the list is empty or nil, otherwise true.

openPopupById.desc: Reads then opens a single popup.

returns.desc: false if the content is not found.

openPopupsByIds.desc: Reads several popups (skipping those not found) and opens them together, in the given order.

returns.desc: false if ids is empty/invalid or if no content was found.

closeTutorialPopup.desc: Closes the displayed tutorial popup (UI hook CloseTutorialPopup).

collectPopupIdsFromRoot.desc: Recursively scans a root and returns the names of subfolders containing content.json or content.html, sorted alphabetically.

root.desc: Root folder (default '/gameplay/tutorials/pages/v2/'); a trailing '/' is added if absent.

openAllPopupsFromRoot.desc: Opens all popups found under a root (useful to preview everything).

options.desc: options.root for the root; the other options are passed to openPopupsByIds.

openDrivingAssistsPopup.desc: Opens the "driving assists" popup (Vue component GearboxSelect, id 'drivingAssists').

openOptionalChallengeSelectionPopup.desc: Opens the optional challenge selection popup (Vue component OptionalChallengeSelect).

openDragTimeslipTutorialPopup.desc: Opens the drag timeslip intro ('v2/dragStripTimeslipIntro') optionally followed by other popups. See the note on the slip variable bug.

openContractSignPopup.desc: Opens the contract signing popup (Vue component ContractSign), with configurable title, text, player name, amount and image, then any additional popups.

options.desc: id, title, text, contractTitle, contractText, userName, money (default 10000), image, root; default texts from the ui.career.tutorial.popup.contractSign.* keys.

showDragTreeStagesPopup.desc: Opens in series the popups dragStripStageCar, dragTreeStages, dragTreeCountdown and dragStripTimeslipIntro.
